node: Battery energy storage, UPS, power conversion, and grid-forming controls for AI loads
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the battery-storage / UPS / power-conversion node with a two-lane funnel. Vertiv remains the obvious reference anchor for data-center critical power, but the underfollowed discovery lane points to Fluence Energy for grid-scale BESS and grid-forming controls, EnerSys for UPS/reserve-power batteries and data-center service, Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter data-center power integration, and Stem as a speculative shadow candidate for storage software/EMS. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
